components.heading: Maximum amount expended.
components.text:
The Council shall provide by resolution the maximum amount which may be expended during any fiscal year from the confidential police investigation fund, which resolution shall provide for a maximum amount of cash which may be maintained on hand at any given time. (Ord. 20206 § 11, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 34-120. Code 1995 § 90-83. Formerly 2.120.120.)
Cross References: City Council – Mayor, Chapter 2.15 TMC.
